newsitem.title: USA: Value Health amends Columbia/HCA merger.
newsitem.headline: Value Health amends Columbia/HCA merger.

text.p: Value Health Inc said it has amended its proposed merger agreement with Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp to a cash transaction in which each outstanding share of Value Health common stock would be exchanged for $20.50.

Under the previous merger pact, each Value Health share would have been exchanged for 0.58 shares of Columbia common stock. That plan had a market value of $18.20 per share of Value Health common stock based on closing stock prices for April 14, 1997.
Value Health said other terms of the revised deal are essentially unchanged from the prior pact.
It said the deal, which is subject to approval from shareholders and regulators, is expected to close in the second quarter.
